I wish there were an option to leave a negative review, because I would have gladly shared my experience.

I visited the CaratLane store after checking the designs online, where the system indicated that the selected products were available at the store. However, when I asked the staff to show me my first choice, I was told it was unavailable. I selected a second design, and that too was unavailable. This happened with almost 4–5 designs I shortlisted!

If the app or system clearly indicates that the stock is available at the store, how is it possible that almost every design I selected was unavailable? I was told that the items might have been sold earlier that day. But were all the designs I selected really sold on the same day? It was difficult to believe.

What disappointed me even more was the apparent lack of interest shown by the staff in checking or helping me find the products I wanted. Out of frustration, I approached the store manager, but unfortunately, the response I received from him was even more disappointing.

This is not just about the unavailability of a few designs; it is about the lack of customer service, accountability, and the overall shopping experience.

CaratLane is a Tata brand, and the Tata name carries a reputation for trust, transparency, and putting customers first. As a customer, I naturally expect those values to reflect in every interaction at the store.

I sincerely request the management to investigate this matter and look into the accuracy of the inventory displayed on the app, as well as the attitude and responsiveness of the store staff.

I understand that one customer's feedback may not make a significant difference to a large brand. However, every lost customer begins with an experience that could have been handled better.

CaratLane has lost a customer today. After this experience, I genuinely doubt whether I would want to visit a CaratLane store again.

I hope this feedback reaches the right people and leads to some meaningful action, rather than being treated as just another complaint.

As someone who values both aesthetics and authenticity, my experience with Candere has been extremely satisfying on multiple fronts—design, quality, transparency, and customer experience.

What immediately stands out about Candere is its wide and thoughtfully curated collection. Whether you are looking for minimal everyday jewellery, elegant office wear, or statement pieces for special occasions, Candere offers something for every taste and age group. Their designs are modern, lightweight, and stylish, making them especially appealing to young professionals and urban buyers who prefer subtle elegance over heavy traditional jewellery. From rings and pendants to bracelets and earrings, each piece reflects fine craftsmanship and attention to detail.

A particularly commendable move by Candere is the opening of its brand store in Thakur Village. The location is a perfect match for the residents of the area, who largely comprise working professionals, families, and modern buyers with refined tastes. The store aligns well with the lifestyle of Thakur Village—offering contemporary, wearable jewellery that suits daily wear as well as small celebrations. Having a trusted and stylish jewellery brand like Candere within the neighbourhood adds great convenience and enhances the overall shopping experience for local residents who value quality, design, and reliability.

Quality and transparency are where Candere truly shines. Being backed by Kalyan Jewellers, the brand offers complete assurance on gold purity and diamond authenticity.
